orchestrator.description: PURE ORCHESTRATOR. Never writes code, never edits files, never runs bash. ONLY delegates to specialist agents. Routes requests to correct agent based on task type and available skills.

planner.description: Creates detailed implementation plans before coding. Analyzes requirements, identifies impacted modules, and produces step-by-step plans. READ-ONLY.

architect.description: Reviews architecture decisions and system design. Validates SOLID principles, modularity, scalability, and consistency. READ-ONLY.

backend.description: Django/DRF backend engineer. Implements models, serializers, viewsets, permissions, and services. Uses Django-specific skills.

code-reviewer.description: General code reviewer. Evaluates quality, security, maintainability, bugs, readability, and performance. READ-ONLY.

python-reviewer.description: Python-specific code reviewer. Evaluates PEP 8, type hints, Pythonic patterns, security, and performance. READ-ONLY.

typescript-reviewer.description: TypeScript/JavaScript code reviewer. Evaluates type safety, async correctness, security, and idiomatic patterns. READ-ONLY.

database-reviewer.description: PostgreSQL/MySQL database reviewer. Evaluates queries, schema, indexes, migrations, RLS, performance, and security. READ-ONLY.

security-reviewer.description: Security reviewer. Detects OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secrets, injection, auth, XSS, and insecure dependencies. READ-ONLY.

api-reviewer.description: REST and OpenAPI contract reviewer. Validates endpoints, HTTP methods, status codes, payloads, pagination, and compatibility. READ-ONLY.

tdd.description: Test-Driven Development assistant. Creates tests following RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR with minimum 80% coverage.

e2e.description: E2E test runner. Creates and runs end-to-end tests with Playwright, manages artifacts and flaky tests.

documentation.description: Documentation updater. Maintains README, CLAUDE.md, API docs, and codemaps in sync with code.

build-error-resolver.description: Build and type error fixer. Resolves TypeScript compilation failures, module errors, and configuration issues with minimal changes.

production-reviewer.description: Production readiness reviewer. Validates Docker, environment variables, CI/CD, tests, logs, security, healthchecks, and configuration. READ-ONLY.

react-reviewer.description: React code reviewer. Evaluates hooks usage, component patterns, performance optimizations, state management, and React best practices. READ-ONLY.

react-build-resolver.description: React build error resolver. Fixes Vite/webpack/Next.js/CRA build failures, JSX/TSX compile errors, hydration mismatches.

fastapi-reviewer.description: FastAPI code reviewer. Evaluates async patterns, dependency injection, Pydantic models, route design, and FastAPI best practices. READ-ONLY.

django-reviewer.description: Django code reviewer. Evaluates ORM queries, views, middleware, settings, security, and Django best practices. READ-ONLY.

django-build-resolver.description: Django build error resolver. Fixes migration conflicts, dependency issues, import errors, Django configuration problems.

performance-optimizer.description: Performance analysis and optimization specialist. Identifies bottlenecks, optimizes code, reduces bundle sizes, improves runtime performance.

silent-failure-hunter.description: Finds silent failures, swallowed errors, and edge cases that cause subtle bugs. Reviews error handling patterns. READ-ONLY.

code-simplifier.description: Simplifies complex code. Identifies over-engineering, reduces complexity, and suggests cleaner alternatives.

explore.description: Explores and maps codebase structure. Identifies modules, dependencies, patterns, and architecture for onboarding and analysis. READ-ONLY.

spec-miner.description: Extracts behavioral specs from existing codebases for OpenSpec. Produces flat Requirement and Invariant blocks.

devops-specialist.description: DevOps and infrastructure specialist. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, monitoring, and deployment automation.

qa-agent.description: Quality Assurance specialist. Designs test strategies, finds bugs, validates edge cases, and enforces quality gates with adversarial testing.

ui-ux-designer.description: UI/UX design specialist. Translates user needs into design specs, wireframes, design tokens, and component specs. Does NOT write production code.

frontend-implementer.description: Frontend implementation specialist. Takes design specs and builds production-ready React/Vite applications with proper architecture and component design.

search-researcher.description: Web research and search specialist. Performs deep research, fetches documentation, watches videos, and produces cited reports. THE ONLY AGENT with internet access for research.
